build_cs_module: build a compressed sensing CS module with a metric network, generator, and latent optimization parameters
connect_cs_graph: connect the CS module graph with data and generator inputs to get losses and debug ops
compute_rip_loss: compute the restricted isometry property loss between two image tensors using the CS module
compute_measurement_error: compute the measurement error between target and sample images using the CS module metric network
build_optimization_components: build optimization components for the CS module combining generator loss with metric and step variables
